integrity: The result distinguishes prior general renewal identities and classical Brownian first-passage laws from the proved exact completion-time amplitude and matching stiffness asymptotics. Numerical diagnostics do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, fixed positive OU search stiffness, exponential switching, target detection in both phases; no joint time/stiffness uniform limit or independent priority determination.
title: Sharp half-moment collapse and weak-confinement singularity in harmonic stochastic return
